_about: Public-domain William Lonsdale Watkinson (1838-1925), Wesleyan Methodist preacher and President of the Wesleyan Conference, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons and short papers from Mistaken Signs (1882) to The Fatal Barter (1909), his life of John Wicklif (1884) and his Fernley Lecture, The Influence of Scepticism on Character (delivered 1886; a printing of 1898). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 71 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
